items.caption: The Federal Reserve's September 15-16 meeting decision is scheduled for Wednesday 16 Sep at 2:00 p.m. ET (21:00 Bucharest); the press conference is scheduled for 2:30 p.m. ET (21:30 Bucharest). For XAUUSD and BTCUSD, watch three things instead of guessing direction: 1) spread/liquidity conditions around the release, 2) the first reaction versus the follow-through after the statement is digested, and 3) whether the press conference changes the market's interpretation. Source: Federal Reserve calendar, verified 14 Sep 2026. This is event-risk context, not a trade call.
